fusions.name: Textbook Buffet
fusions.desc: A drilled wing-strike that deals 26 damage, is always a critical hit and knocks the target back 3 tiles. It leaves the target 12% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Opening Form
fusions.desc: Flicks a bead of water that deals 4 damage, with 30% more critical chance against a target that has not yet been wounded.

fusions.name: Collect Yourself
fusions.desc: Clears the cooldown on one of your other abilities, chosen at random from those still waiting, and moves you 2 tiles from where you stood, with 10% more dodge chance.

fusions.name: Rehearsed Takeoff
fusions.desc: Every time you use an ability, a stack builds on you, up to 5. At 5 they all spend at once: you move and attack 5% faster per stack (23% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
